offers_products.reason: Sells women's and men's ready-to-wear, cashmere knitwear, leather, shoes, accessories and home collection.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from apparel and accessories; no main service offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells directly to shoppers via its own stores and vince.com website.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Wholesale channel sells apparel to department stores and specialty retailers for resale.

recurring_revenue.reason: Seasonal fashion apparel purchases are discretionary, repeat-driven but not contracted or subscription-based.

cyclical_demand.reason: Luxury apparel like cashmere and leather outerwear is discretionary and easily postponed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Individual clothing items are relatively small, frequent purchases rather than large infrequent ones.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for designed apparel goods, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual shoppers; wholesale department stores are secondary.

asset_heavy.reason: Designs apparel made by contract manufacturers; leased retail stores, modest capital needs.
